title: Forms
description: Lead forms for your website; submissions land in the CRM as leads.
slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (e.g. freight-quote).

list.label: Forms
list.emptyDescription: Create your first lead form, add it to your website and let submissions flow into the CRM.

deleteDialog.title: Delete form?
deleteDialog.description: “{{name}}” and all its versions will be deleted permanently.

create.title: New form
create.description: The form starts with contact fields and a consent box, mapped to the lead automatically.
create.name: Form name

preview.title: Preview: {{name}}
preview.description: Fill in the form to try it; submissions are not saved.

builder.nameInvalid: The form name must be 2–80 characters.

leave.title: Changes could not be saved
leave.description: Your latest changes could not be saved. They will be lost if you leave.

palette.title: Add field
palette.label: Field palette
palette.addHint: Click to add or drag onto the canvas.

canvas.label: Fields of the step
canvas.empty: This step has no fields yet
canvas.emptyHint: Add fields from the palette or drag and drop them here.

steps.label: Form steps
steps.title: Step title
steps.removeHint: Its fields move to the previous step.

dnd.instructions: To move, press space, use the arrow keys to choose the new position and press space again to drop. Press Escape to cancel.

properties.title: Field properties
properties.emptyHint: Click a field on the canvas to edit its properties.
properties.label: Label
properties.keyHelp: Used in submission data and exports.
properties.keyInvalid: Enter a key that starts with a lowercase letter and has letters and digits only.

logic.title: Conditional logic
logic.description: Show, hide or require fields and steps based on the answers given.
logic.emptyHint: For example, show the dimensions field when the transport mode is “Air”.
logic.noFields: Add an answer field to the form before creating rules.
logic.cycleTitle: Cyclic rules — the form cannot be published
logic.cycle: Fields showing and hiding each other: {{fields}}
logic.broken: This rule refers to a deleted field or step.
logic.incomplete: Complete the rule: enter the condition value and choose at least one target.

mapping.title: CRM mapping
mapping.description: Each submission creates a {{object}} record. Map the form fields to {{object}} fields.
mapping.unmappedHint: Unmapped answers are kept with the submission too.

required.title: Required {{object}} fields
required.description: The form cannot be published until these are mapped. Stage and owner are set by the server.

issues.requiredTarget: The required field {{target}} is not mapped.
issues.requiredTargetOptional: The required field {{target}} is fed by an optional field.
issues.typeMismatch: The field type does not match {{target}}.
issues.unknownField: The mapped form field was deleted.
issues.duplicateTarget: {{target}} is also fed by another form field.
issues.duplicateNeedsEmail: Map an email field to an email target to link contacts.

duplicate.title: Duplicate rule
duplicate.description: How should submissions from the same person be handled?
duplicate.create: Create a new lead for every submission
duplicate.createHint: Default; duplicates can be merged in the list.
duplicate.linkContactByEmail: Link to an existing contact by email
duplicate.linkContactByEmailHint: If a contact with the same email exists, the new lead is linked to it.
duplicate.needsEmail: Map an email field to an email target first.

assignment.title: Assignment & tracking
assignment.description: Owner and source information of created records.

tracking.title: UTM and referrer
tracking.description: Capture campaign parameters and the referring page with hidden fields.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: How the form looks on your website.

contrast.buttonContrast: Button text is hard to read on the primary color ({{ratio}}:1, at least 4.5:1 needed).
contrast.textContrast: Low contrast between text and background ({{ratio}}:1, at least 4.5:1 needed).
contrast.accentContrast: The primary color barely stands out from the background ({{ratio}}:1, at least 3:1 needed).

submit.title: Submission
submit.description: Button, thank-you message, notifications and spam protection.
submit.redirectHelp: When set, visitors go to this page instead of seeing the success message.
submit.redirectInvalid: Enter a valid address starting with https://.
submit.limitHelp: The form stops accepting submissions at this number.
submit.limitInvalid: Enter a positive whole number or leave it empty.
submit.honeypotHelp: A hidden field bots fill in; such submissions are silently rejected.

emails.label: Notification recipients
emails.description: These addresses get an email for every new submission.

languages.title: Language & link
languages.description: Languages the form is offered in and its web address.
